author: reek
body: A raymarched 3D scene as a [Device] compute kernel: one GPU thread per pixel casts a ray, sphere-traces a signed-distance field (a sphere on a floor), shades the hit with diffuse lighting from a rotating light, and writes a packed colour. This exercises both new plug features at once -- float (f32) math generated from Codex Real, and the march loop generated from a tail- recursive Codex helper.

author: reek
body: Real math (real-sqrt, real-sin, real-cos, real-min, real-max) comes from Gpu chapter DeviceMath, which has correct portable bodies; the plug replaces the calls with hardware ops on the GPU. Integer conversion uses the compiler builtins real-from-int / real-to-int.

author: reek
body: A unit sphere at the origin sitting on a floor plane at y = -1.1. The scene distance is the nearer of the two.

author: reek
body: Sphere tracing: step along the ray by the scene distance until we are within epsilon of a surface (return t) or exceed the far plane / step budget (return -1). Tail-recursive -> WGSL loop.
